adaptive_suggestion:
```python
import pandas as pd

class DataCleaning:
    def __init__(self):
        self.actions_log = []

    def clean(self, data: pd.DataFrame):
        # Clip outliers
        self.actions_log.append("Clipping VehAge (<=20), DrivAge (<=90), BonusMalus (<=150), ClaimNb (<=5).")
        data['VehAge'] = data['VehAge'].clip(upper=20)
        data['DrivAge'] = data['DrivAge'].clip(upper=90)
        data['BonusMalus'] = data['BonusMalus'].clip(upper=150)
        data['ClaimNb'] = data['ClaimNb'].clip(upper=5)

        # Encode categorical variables
        self.actions_log.append("One-hot encoding Area, VehBrand, VehGas, Region.")
        data = pd.get_dummies(data, columns=['Area', 'VehBrand', 'VehGas', 'Region'])

        # Remove duplicates
        self.actions_log.append("Removing duplicate rows.")
        data = data.drop_duplicates()

        # Remove empty columns
        empty_cols = data.columns[data.isna().all()].tolist()
        if empty_cols:
            data = data.drop(columns=empty_cols)

        # Remove missing values
        self.actions_log.append("Removing rows with missing values.")
        data = data.dropna()

        return data
```
